Name: SpookyTime Bobbers
Author: 0Logophile0
Description:
[center][/center][center][font=Georgia][size=5]Celebrate Spooky Season with this themed collection of fishing rod bobbers.[/size][/font][/center]


[left][img]https://cdn.nest.rip/uploads/f5009878-8b41-46f1-818b-4a531a378972.png[/img]﻿[/left][left][font=Georgia][size=4]Cast off in style with 9 new bobber types, available from the Bobber Machine in Willy's shop:
[spoiler][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Alien[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Bat[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Ghost[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Golden Pumpkin[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Monster[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Mummy[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Pumpkin[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Skull[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Tiger Slime[/size][/font]
[/spoiler][/list][/size][/font][/left]

[left][img]https://cdn.nest.rip/uploads/10dc5b63-e2aa-433b-9b9c-3b825485ef41.png[/img][/left][left][font=Georgia][size=4]1. Download this mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36655]Bebber Bobbers[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ (if you don't already have it).
2. Extract zip file and place in your /Mods folder.
3. Launch game and start fishing![/size][/font][/left]


[left][img]https://cdn.nest.rip/uploads/0a31af6f-6760-48b2-b6b0-fc59c85c13da.png[/img][/left][left][font=Georgia][size=4][u]Thanks to:
[/u][list]
[*][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Spiderbuttons?gameId=1303]Spiderbuttons[/url]﻿ for making the Bebber Bobbers framework and for the quick testing. 🩵
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/140245483]VinillaBean[/url]﻿ for the amazing lesson on dynamic tokens, and for helping make version 1.0 more efficient! ❣️❣️
[*]momoichan, whose mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18499]Duck Fishing Rod Buoy[/url]﻿ inspired me to make this themed collection for spooky month.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]pathoschild[/url], without whom we wouldn't have SDV mods, let alone silly ones for spooky month.
[*]And as always, thanks to the incredible, supportive people in the SDV Modding Discord community. 🥰
[/list][/size][/font][/left]
